clauses.why: NUM 32:39 says the children of Machir went to Gilead and took it, so the verse does not say Machir himself did it.

clauses.english: was given Gilead by Moses and dwelt there

clauses.deu: bekam von Mose Gilead und wohnte darin
clauses.spa: recibió de Moisés Galaad y habitó en ella
